name: unquarantine
title: Unquarantine
description: Open Gatekeeper-blocked downloads from Raycast — one command, one confirm, no Touch ID
author: jack

commands.name: unquarantine-latest
commands.title: Unquarantine Latest App
commands.subtitle: Gatekeeper
commands.description: Clear the most recent app Gatekeeper is blocking, after one confirmation

commands.name: open-anyway
commands.title: Open Anyway
commands.subtitle: Gatekeeper
commands.description: Open Security settings and locate the blocked app; you click Open Anyway

commands.name: unquarantine-apps
commands.title: Unquarantine Apps
commands.subtitle: Gatekeeper
commands.description: Browse apps Gatekeeper blocks, or everything carrying the quarantine attribute

commands.name: unquarantine-finder-selection
commands.title: Unquarantine Finder Selection
commands.subtitle: Gatekeeper
commands.description: Clear the quarantine attribute from the current Finder selection

commands.name: open-security-settings
commands.title: Open Security Settings
commands.subtitle: Gatekeeper
commands.description: Jump straight to Privacy & Security › Security, no scrolling

preferences.name: extraPaths
preferences.title: Extra Scan Folders
preferences.description: Comma-separated folders to scan in addition to /Applications, ~/Applications and ~/Downloads

preferences.name: adhocSign
preferences.title: Re-sign After Unquarantining
preferences.label: Also run codesign --sign - (ad-hoc)
preferences.description: For apps that still report being damaged after the attribute is cleared

preferences.name: language
preferences.title: Interface Language
preferences.description: Language for messages and dialogs. Command names above are set by Raycast and cannot be translated.
